description: List certificates whose status changed recently (Certificate Manager 2.0). Give exactly one of minutes, seconds, or startDateTime+endDateTime — omitting all is rejected (2101) and giving minutes and seconds together returns 0 rows. Public zone only. Requires a main-account API key — Certificate Manager 2.0 rejects Sub Account keys with HTTP 403 (confirmed by Ncloud support; verified 2026-10-02 with NCP_ADMINISTRATOR).

endDateTime.description: End of the window (use with startDateTime)

minutes.description: Changes in the last N minutes (1-10080)

seconds.description: Changes in the last N seconds (1-604800)

startDateTime.description: Start of the window (use with endDateTime)

name: ncloud_cm2_list_recent_changes
